NameMultiLanguage.zh: 危机合约-武林寺庙第三部分-绝境-day47

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: A large number of zombies are replaced with a moderate number of Bronze
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 大量僵尸被替换为中量铜人

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Summoning intervals vary for all Chi Bronze. Some Chi Bronze have -30% health and only summon themselves; some gain +150% movement speed and only summon normal Monks; some gain +30% health and only summon special Monks
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有气功铜人的召唤间隔不同程度变化；部分气功铜人的生命值-30%，仅召唤自身；部分气功铜人的移动速度+150%，仅召唤普通武僧；部分气功铜人的生命值+30%，仅召唤特殊武僧

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All Hook Bronze gain +300% movement speed and have significantly reduced chain-throwing interval
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有侠客铜人的移动速度+300%，掷出锁链的间隔超大幅缩短

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: All Strong Bronze have -25% movement speed and are harder to enrage, but gain +50% health with massively increased enraged attack and movement speed
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 所有大汉铜人的移动速度-25%，更加不易狂暴，但是生命值+50%，狂暴的攻速和移速超大幅提升

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Special Bronze Statues appear in some waves, some waves and dynamic spawning are modified, and certain plants are disabled
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 特殊铜人像会在某些波次出现，部分波次和动态出怪有所不同，禁用部分植物
